sections.heading: HOD, MCA Department
sections.content:
The department of Master of Computer Applications (MCA) has been established in the academic year 2023-24. The current student intake capacity is 120.
The Department has dedicated and qualified faculty to ensure a high standard of teaching – learning and evaluation processes. The department has well-equipped laboratories consisting of the state-of-the-art servers & computers used by the students of MCA. The main aim of the MCA department is to bring out some of the brightest minds into the world of computer software and technology. The motto of our department is to provide quality technical education to students, which will lead them sustain peaks in the field of technology. OUR STRENGTHS: 1. Holistic student learning environment 2. Good Infrastructure 3. Effective Teaching and Learning Methods (Using ICT) 4. Dedicated and Qualified Faculty 5. Excellent Academic Results 6. Active Participation in Curricular, Co-curricular, and Extracurricular Activities
